result.sql:
WITH invoices AS (
SELECT COUNT(*) documents,COUNT(DISTINCT doc_entry) unique_documents,COUNT(doc_total) amount_documents,
COALESCE(SUM(CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))),0) amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/staging/sales-continuity-recovery-v1.0.0/sales-continuity-candidate-20261029-v1/sales_document.parquet')) WHERE source_system=? AND canceled=? AND currency=? AND doc_date>=? AND doc_date<? 
), credits AS (
SELECT COUNT(*) documents,COUNT(DISTINCT doc_entry) unique_documents,COUNT(doc_total) amount_documents,
COALESCE(SUM(CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))),0) amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/staging/sales-continuity-recovery-v1.0.0/sales-continuity-candidate-20261029-v1/credit_memo_document.parquet')) WHERE source_system=? AND canceled=? AND currency=? AND doc_date>=? AND doc_date<? 
)
SELECT i.documents invoice_count,i.unique_documents unique_invoices,i.amount billed_amount,
c.documents credit_count,c.unique_documents unique_credits,c.amount credit_amount,
i.amount-c.amount net_amount,i.amount_documents invoice_amount_count,c.amount_documents credit_amount_count
FROM invoices i CROSS JOIN credits c
result.limitations: DocDate; active N; BS only; DocTotal retains source taxes/discounts. Not cash collections. Historical completeness and separate tax/discount reconciliation not certified.
